{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Pokémon Power'' (magazine)}}
'''''Pokémon Power''''' is the name of a series of mini-magazines which were included in the ''[[Nintendo Power]]'' magazine. The magazines were available as inserts in Nintendo Power volumes 111 through 116, spanning the months of August 1998 until January 1999. The magazines contained strategies for [[Pokémon Red and Blue Versions]] as well as Ani-Manga adaptations of the first six animated series episodes, translated from the Japanese [[Pocket Monsters Film Comic]] series.

The Ani-Manga chapters from these magazines was later released in a volume by [[VIZ Media]], titled [[Pokémon TV Animation Comic - I Choose You!]].

==In other languages==
The magazines were translated into {{pmin|France|European French}} with the title ''{{tt|Pokémon Attrapez-les tous!|Pokémon Catch them all!}}''. At least the first four issues are known to have been translated.
